gloss: personal data leak; leak of personal information

definitions.gloss: personal data leak; leak of personal information
definitions.explanation: The unauthorized release of personally identifiable information—names, addresses, ID numbers, account details—often as the result of a security breach, lost device, or insider misuse. A staple topic of corporate apologies and news headlines.
